subject: general
question: The average weight of 14 boys in a class is 40.25 kg and that of the remaining 10 boys is 35.15 kg. Find the average weight of all the boys in the class.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__**

Average weight of 14 boys = 40.25 kg

Average age of 10 boys = 35.15 kg

Total no. of boys = 24

So, Average weight of 24 boys

⇒ [(14 × 40.25) + (10 × 35.15)]/24

⇒ [563.5 + 351.5]/24 = 38.125 kg

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Average weight of 14 boys = 40.25 kg

Average age of 10 boys = 35.15 kg

Total no. of boys = 24

Formula:

Average = Sum of total observations/No. of observations

Calculation:

Sum of the weight of 14 boys = 14 × 40.25 = 563.5 kg

Sum of the weight of 10 boys = 10 × 35.15 kg = 351.5 kg

Sum of total weight = 563.5 + 351.5 = 915 kg

⇒ Average = 915/(14 + 10) = 38.125 kg

∴The average weight of all boys was 38.125 kg.
